summary: __cdecl helper that builds a 6-element unsigned 16-bit local buffer v3 by calling sub_596245 with the address of a2, a2 itself, and five zero arguments, then delegates to DelegationWithStaticData(v3, a1) and returns its result. Likely parses a string using a format/argument descriptor.

operations.description: Call sub_596245(v3, &a2, a2, 0, 0, 0, 0) to fill the local buffer v3 from a2 and the zero arguments.
Call DelegationWithStaticData(v3, a1) with the filled buffer and the first argument.
Return the result of DelegationWithStaticData(v3, a1).

unresolved: Layout and meaning of the v3 buffer produced by sub_596245 are unknown.
Purpose of the zero arguments and of the repeated a2/&a2 pair passed to sub_596245 is unknown.
The role of static data consumed by DelegationWithStaticData is unknown.
